title: Strictly perfect stalk and residue fibre comparison
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], E an object of its derived category [def-pc-derived-category], x a point, and G a complex of structure-sheaf modules with Q(G) isomorphic to E. Suppose E has a strictly perfect representative on a neighbourhood of x [def-pc-perfect-complex] and every derived fibre cohomology space at x is finite-dimensional [def-sc-derived-fiber-betti]. Write C for the termwise stalk of G [def-pc-module-stalk-functor], over R = O_{X,x}. Then Q(C) is pseudo-coherent [def-pc-ring-pseudo-coherent-complex]. For a witness hK of this pseudo-coherence, the bounded-above finite-free representative selected by hK has finite-dimensional residue-tensor cohomology in every degree, with dimension equal to the derived fibre Betti number of E at x. The chosen derived category of R-modules can have a different morphism universe from the sheaf derived category.

source.place: Tag 0BCD, local-ring paragraph; Tags 08EB, 06YB and 01AG, stalk and residue comparison

proof.text: Apply exists_localStrictPerfect_stalk_projective_model to eG and hlocal, obtaining L, bounds a,b, finite projective terms, and the derived stalk comparison. The upper bound supplies L.IsStrictlyLE b via isStrictlyLE_iff.

For each degree use projective-implies-flat (Mathlib Module.Flat.of_projective) and finite-flat local freeness (Module.free_of_flat_of_isLocalRing). Assemble L, its upper bound, finite-free terms and derived comparison into hK : IsPseudoCoherent Q(G_x).

Destructure Classical.choose_spec hK to recover the upper bound, free terms and derived comparison of Classical.choose hK. Apply the bounded-above free residue-cohomology comparison to this chosen complex in each degree. Install hfin i over the definitionally equal ring residue field and transport it by Module.Finite.equiv. LinearEquiv.finrank_eq gives the Betti equality by unfolding its definition. Return hK with both families of conclusions.

theorem strictPerfect_stalk_fiberData
    (X : Scheme.{u})
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ U : X.Opens,
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U))]
    [∀ x : X, HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u}
      (moduleRings (Spec (X.residueField x)).toRingedSpace))]
    (E : schemeDerivedCategory X) (x : X)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{v} (ModuleCat.{u} (X.presheaf.stalk x))]
    (G : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) ℤ)
    (eG : DerivedCategory.Q.obj G ≅ E)
    (hlocal : ∃ V : X.Opens, x ∈ V ∧
      ∃ P : CochainComplex
          (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over V)) ℤ,
        IsStrictlyPerfect X V P ∧
        Nonempty ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u}
          (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) V).mapDerivedCategory.obj E ≅
          DerivedCategory.Q.obj P))
    (hfin : ∀ i : ℤ, Module.Finite (X.residueField x) (derivedFiberCohomology X E i x)) :
    ∃ hK : DerivedCategory.IsPseudoCoherent (DerivedCategory.Q.obj
      (((RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor X.toRingedSpace x).mapHomologicalComplex
        (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj G)),
      (∀ i : ℤ, Module.Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField (X.presheaf.stalk x))
        ((((ModuleCat.extendScalars
          (IsLocalRing.residue (X.presheaf.stalk x))).mapHomologicalComplex
            (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj (Classical.choose hK)).homology i)) ∧
      (∀ i : ℤ, derivedFiberBetti X E i x =
        Module.finrank (IsLocalRing.ResidueField (X.presheaf.stalk x))
          ((((ModuleCat.extendScalars
            (IsLocalRing.residue (X.presheaf.stalk x))).mapHomologicalComplex
            (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj (Classical.choose hK)).homology i))
